summary: P3A 'Salin Foto Referensi' verified end-to-end (UI + API + DB). Clone dialog shows new checkbox default-CHECKED alongside the other 6 'Yang Disalin' toggles. Backend pytest 96/96 GREEN. Full clone-with-photos flow exercised via API: V1 -> V10 produced 3 cloned FileAssets (bundle+wi_step+mistake), each with new id, file_url, shared storage_path, source_file_id pointing to V1, product_sku=V10. qc_evidence never copied. Revision history entry 'Foto Referensi' created. All independence guarantees verified: delete-on-clone does NOT affect V1 (soft-delete only); replace-on-clone generates a NEW storage_path; caption edit on V10 leaves V1 untouched. Clone V1 -> V11 with copy_photos=False produces photos=0.

minor.issue: FileAsset created via /api/uploads has product_sku=None (only clone fills it). Makes batch cleanup by SKU impossible without joining via bundle/mistake ids. Consider deriving product_sku from related_id at upload time.
No hard-delete endpoint exists; tests/admins must purge clones via direct DB. Consider adding admin-only hard-delete for cloned drafts to ease test cleanup.
Requires related_id query param. There is no way to list all files for a product_sku in one call. Useful for the new copy_photos feature audit (counting/verifying clones).

action_items: (Optional) Auto-derive product_sku in /api/uploads when related_type ∈ {bundle, common_mistake, work_instruction_step} to enable per-SKU file listing/cleanup.
(Optional) Add DELETE /api/products/{sku}?hard=true for Admin to enable proper test cleanup of cloned drafts.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py clone block (lines ~386-475) is well-structured; reuses storage_path, generates new ids, sets source_file_id, scopes by bundle_id_map/mistake_id_map/prefix-swap, and explicitly excludes qc_evidence. No issues found.
CloneProductDialog.jsx defaults copy_photos=true and renders 'Salin Foto Referensi' alongside other options. Looks clean.
Minor: file_assets created via /api/uploads do NOT set product_sku; the clone path does. This asymmetry can confuse downstream audit queries — see backend minor item.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned V10/V11 cloned products + 3 test photos on V1; all hard-deleted via direct MongoDB cleanup. V1 restored to status=Released.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P3A 'Salin Foto Referensi' is complete and stable. Backend 96/96 GREEN with -n 0 (parallel xdist still causes race conditions in TestP3APhotoClone; keep -n 0). E2E script saved at /tmp/e2e_clone_photos.py exercises full clone flow including independence guarantees. For future cleanup, use direct mongo (no DELETE /products endpoint). Stale file_assets on V1 bundles from prior test runs can be cleaned by querying product_bundles for ids and deleting file_assets where related_id matches.
rca of the issue: No issues found in the P3A feature itself. The single soft-deleted V1 row that lingered post-test is by design (DELETE /api/files soft-deletes; storage object preserved for clone sources). Production-deployable as-is.
